Sofia — thanks for the ping. I reviewed the redlines and sketched inline proposals in the attached Redline_suggestion_legal.docx. High-level:

- Most of their edits are standard (retention, subprocessor disclosure cadence).
- Their SCCs mapping request is reasonable; we'll provide a controls-to-SCCs mapping matrix but we should limit the level of operational detail (we can provide control IDs, policy references, and attestation).
- The encryption-at-rest ask: we can provide an architecture diagram and an attestation. Avoid sending keys/diagrams with operational secrets — redact specifics.
- DPIA: we should send them our DPIA intake link and offer a 30-min call with privacy to walk through any nuances.

Open question for sales/legal: they want the DPA signed within 9 business days. We can aim for a near-final redline by EOD tomorrow if sales confirms go/no-go and we offer a short escrow-like concession on the indemnity cap wording (we propose adding an explicit liability carve-out instead of increasing cap).

I attached the suggested redlines and the short outline of what we can commit to sharing.

Marissa

Hi Alyssa — thanks for sending this over and for the clear checklist. We appreciate the timeline. Quick update and proposed next steps: 

1) Redline review: Legal has proposed minor compromises and a suggested set of edits (see attached docx). We believe we can reach agreement without changing the core liability cap if FinnovA can accept the alternate indemnity language Marissa proposes.

2) SCCs mapping: we'll deliver a controls-to-SCCs mapping matrix (redwood_controls_to_sccs.pdf) that maps our SOC2 controls to the SCC clauses. This will include control IDs and policy references (not raw logs).

3) SOC2 evidence: we can provide our SOC2 summary report (summary PDF) and a one-page attestation of scope and last audit date. We'll not share the full SOC2 report until the SOW is signed and an NDA-like access agreement is in place (standard practice).

4) Encryption & KMS: we'll provide an architecture diagram and a short attestation confirming encryption at rest and KMS usage (see planned attachments).

5) DPIA: please complete our DPIA intake form at the link below; privacy will triage and schedule a call if needed.

Proposed schedule: Legal final redlines by EOD 9/9 -> send to you 9/10 -> DocuSign sent 9/12 -> signature target 9/14–9/17. Does that work on your end?

Links: DPIA intake: https://docs.redwood.com/dpia/intake/FN-4821

Let me know any must-haves we missed and we'll prioritize.

Thanks,
Sofia
Senior Sales Manager, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
